description:
`use_observable/1` (hooks.ex ~213) takes a server reference or a 0-arity factory fn and returns the resolved pid (or `nil` when disconnected). Cell needs the equivalent so example components can keep doing:

    server = use_observable(fn -> CartServer.ensure_started(session_id) end)
    count  = use_observable(server, fn ... end)

…but with cells:

    cell  = use_cell(fn -> {Filament.Observable.GenServer, CartServer.ensure_started(session_id)} end)
    count = use_cell(cell, fn ... end)

Decide whether `use_cell/1` resolves a factory or wraps a value, and whether `:disconnected` flows through naturally. Add coverage for the factory + lazy-start case (CartServer pattern in `examples/cart/lib/cart_web/components/cart.ex`).
title: Add use_cell/1 factory-fn form
